The '''concealed dart launcher''' was a type of [[dart shooter]] usually worn on the wrist and concealed by clothing. In [[137 ABY]] while on a bounty hunting mission, [[Deliah Blue]] used her dart launcher during an encounter with a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Hosk Trey'lis]].

The concealed [[Dart/Legends|dart]] launcher fired [[Poison dart/Legends|toxic darts]] filled a potent sedative designed to incapacitate a target. However it could also be filled with other types of [[Poison/Legends|poisons]]. Because of its compact design, a concealed dart launcher was difficult to detect. Owning this weapon was illegal in all but specific, highly regulated circumstances.<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide" /> [[Deliah Blue]] often used a concealed dart launcher to bring down her targets quickly and without causing lethal damage.<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide" />
